rationale: The specific mechanism behind the entry — bounces stalling under the 5m 9-EMA — has failed: three consecutive higher closes culminating in a 53.15 print above the 9-EMA ($53.07) on rising volume (9k vs 1–7k on prior bars), leaving price 11 cents from the $53.25 invalidation with a max favorable excursion of just 0.02%. The broader fade context (still ~1.9% under VWAP, red SPY) argues against flipping long midday into a counter-trend bounce, but with the short's structure broken and the midday-stabilization risk flagged at entry now materializing, exiting to flat is better than holding into a likely stop-out through a wide spread.
